about.title: One firm, one management, since 1976
text: We were established in March 1976 and have been under the same management ever since.
We are large enough to give you up-to-date technology in managing your property, but small enough to give you and your property the attention it deserves.
Norman Edmonson is our property manager and the primary contact for our owners and tenants, and our office runs on a strong work-together philosophy.
